=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6302 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-helper guard falls back to the checkout's `scripts/` when `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR` is unset, so a branch-controlled helper can run with `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in scope. minimax_minimax-m3 also flags the `codex_thread_reuse.sh` check on line 6280 and the `diagnose_command` fallback.
  WHY: This is a trust-boundary regression, because the helper can come from the checked-out branch instead of the verified staged copy. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 found no regression and did not report it. qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it NIT with confidence 2, calling it a pre-existing pattern. The highest severity is used.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:786-804 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the paginated comments read fails, the comments file is emptied and the marker dedup reports "no marker", so `ai:plan-superseded:v1` is posted again.
  WHY: A sustained read failure plus retries produces one duplicate comment per attempt. The impact is comment noise, and the step still exits 0. All four reviewers rated it NIT, so no severity disagreement; the severity field here is "medium" only to fit the schema, and the source rating is NIT.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:736-748 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `blocked_handoff()` dedup only guards the label-failure case, so a re-dispatch on an issue already carrying `ai:blocked` posts another `ai:implement-pr-not-open:v1` comment.
  WHY: Repeated dispatches accumulate near-identical comments. The impact is noise only (source rating NIT).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:735 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In `notify()`, `ISSUE_URL` is only exported by the skipped "Fetch issue metadata" step, so the Telegram message ends with an empty `Issue: ` line.
  WHY: The alert lacks the issue link. The impact is cosmetic (source rating NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~736-748 (`blocked_handoff()`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment says the hand-off comment is posted only after the label landed, so a retry does not post it twice. Only the label-failure case is guarded. A re-dispatch on an issue already carrying `ai:blocked` posts another `ai:implement-pr-not-open:v1` comment.
  WHY: Repeated dispatches accumulate near-identical comments. The impact is noise only.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~786-787, ~800-804 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the comments listing fails, the file is emptied and the dedup check reports "no marker", so `ai:plan-superseded:v1` is posted again.
  WHY: A sustained read failure plus step retries yields one duplicate per attempt. The impact is bounded, because the step exits 0.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~735 (`notify()`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ISSUE_URL` is exported later by the skipped "Fetch issue metadata" step, so the Telegram message ends with an empty `Issue: ` line.
  WHY: The alert lacks the issue link. Cosmetic only.
(All other categories: NONE. The reviewer checked the diagnose-helper guard and found no new trust-boundary regression. No task gaps.)

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6278 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic helper guard falls back to the checkout's scripts/ directory.
  WHY: If IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR is unset, the guard checks scripts/, which could be controlled by a CI-triage PR branch. That allows untrusted code to run with the diagnostic step's privileges.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:736-748 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The dedup logic fails to prevent duplicate hand-off comments when retries occur on an issue that already has the ai:blocked label.
  WHY: Dedup is only checked if label_state is applied. If the label edit fails or is not applied, the guard is bypassed and duplicate comments can be posted.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:786-787 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The superseded-path marker dedup fails open.
  WHY: If gh api fails to list comments, the file is emptied, the grep fails, and a duplicate ai:plan-superseded:v1 comment is posted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6278, 6302 (also the `diagnose_command` fallback and the `codex_thread_reuse.sh` test on line 6280) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-step guard uses `${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR:-scripts}`. When the variable is unset it falls back to the branch-controlled `scripts/`, with `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in scope. The `codex_thread_reuse.sh` test and `diagnose_command` use the same fallback.
  WHY: The fix should skip rather than source from the checkout. agents.md §7159 documents that host helpers must run from the staged copy.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:786-787, 800-804 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed comments read truncates the comments file, the marker check sees no marker, and `ai:plan-superseded:v1` is posted again.
  WHY: Under a sustained outage with retries, one duplicate comment is posted per retry. The step still exits 0 and the duplicates are noise only.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6278, 6280 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard is also implicit execution from a checkout-relative path with credentials in scope, at two sites in the same step (the helper and `codex_thread_reuse.sh`). The #7540 hand-off step shows the right pattern.
  WHY: A PR whose head is no longer open by the time the diagnose step runs could supply its own helper and exfiltrate `GH_PAT` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Implement no longer fails when a CI-triage pull request has already merged or closed." The skipped path should log the refusal reason, and a `reason` that merely starts with `pr_not_open` should still fail closed.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/implement.yml:622-637
  Evidence of absence: The grep anchors `reason=pr_not_open` with `$`, so `pr_not_open_extra` does not match. The test confirms this and the implementation is correct. | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: agents.md §30 direct-edit limits.
  Expected change site: agents.md:1287
  Evidence of absence: The direct edit and the `agents.d/7540-implement-ci-triage-pr-not-open.md` fragment describe the same change, leaving duplicate prose after the fold. This is a maintenance hazard, not a strict violation. | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6278: replace the guard with an explicit `-z` / `! -f` check on the staged dir, and apply the same change to line 6280 and `diagnose_command` (about 4 lines). (2) .github/workflows/implement.yml:786-787: on comments-read failure set `comment_state=skipped` instead of re-posting (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275-6277, 6302 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper-existence guard falls back to `scripts/` when `IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR` is unset. If checkout succeeded but support staging did not, a helper from the checked-out branch satisfies the guard and is executed.
  WHY: The checkout can be the issue's integration branch (line 1222), and the diagnose step receives `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (lines 6257-6258). A branch-controlled helper can run with those credentials.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:787-804 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If the paginated comments read fails, the command truncates the comments file and proceeds as if no superseded marker exists.
  WHY: A retry after that failure posts another `ai:plan-superseded:v1` comment, reachable when the read fails but the POST succeeds and a later hand-off is triggered.
(HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 5)
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6275 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The diagnose-helper guard uses `${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR:-scripts}` as its fallback. When the variable is unset, the fallback is the checked-out repository's `scripts/`, and line 6302 could run a branch-controlled helper.
  WHY: The step receives `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. The reviewer notes this is a pre-existing pattern used in 70+ places, and that the checkout is the default branch at that point, so the risk is theoretical here.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
